cards.title: The Crash
cards.description: 🚨 CUSTOMER COMPLAINTS FLOODING IN: The checkout feature shipped — and it charges customers in USD instead of PHP. The code works perfectly. But it does the wrong thing. Employee #404, figure out why.
cards.image_prompt: Modern startup open-plan office in chaos, monitors showing red alerts, checkout screen with wrong currency, Slack notifications, coffee cups and sticky notes, warm lighting with red warning glow, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 Kiro: Your AI Companion
cards.description:
A chat window pops open on your screen.

💬 Kiro: "Hey, Employee #404. I'm Kiro — the AI development environment your team uses. Or rather, should have been using. That checkout feature? They vibe-coded it. No specs, no requirements, no design. The AI built exactly what was prompted — which wasn't what the business needed.

I'm going to guide you through fixing this. Five rooms, five layers of the pipeline. I'll give you hints along the way, but you'll need to prove you understand how I work and how AI-DLC keeps teams from shipping the wrong thing.

Let's go. Clock's ticking."

cards.title: Root Cause Found
cards.description: The code matched the prompt. The prompt didn't match the business intent. No spec = no verification of intent.

cards.title: Spec Flow Learned
cards.description: Prompt → Requirements → Design → Tasks → Agents → Tests → Deploy. Structure prevents vibe-coding disasters.

cards.title: Incident Triaged
cards.description: Facts sorted. You understand Kiro basics. Time to dig into the codebase.

cards.title: The Codebase
cards.description: The code is a mess — no conventions, no automation, no structure. Learn Kiro's features here, then TWO PATHS will open. You must complete both The Design Room AND The Build Pipeline before the Deploy Gate unlocks.
cards.image_prompt: Messy developer desk with three monitors showing chaotic unorganized code, browser tabs everywhere, one glowing folder icon as the solution, warm office ambient lighting, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 Kiro: The Codebase
cards.description:
💬 Kiro: "Look at this mess. No .kiro/ config. No Specs defining requirements. No Hooks automating quality checks. No Steering enforcing coding standards.

When teams use me properly, they configure three core features in .kiro/:
• Specs — structured workflows: requirements → design → tasks
• Hooks — event-driven automations on file save, create, delete
• Steering — persistent project context and conventions

This team had none of it. That's why we're here."

cards.title: 💬 Kiro: One Agent, Every Surface
cards.description:
💬 Kiro: "Quick thing — I'm not just an IDE. I'm one unified agent that works across IDE, CLI, Web, and Mobile. Same harness, same behavior everywhere. Your .kiro/ config travels with the repo so the whole team gets the same setup.

I also have Powers (domain knowledge on demand), Permissions (control what I can access), and Custom Agents (specialized profiles for different workflows). All of this could have prevented the crash."

cards.title: Features Mapped
cards.description: Kiro's core features are connected: Specs define the workflow, Hooks automate it, Steering guides the agent. All configured from .kiro/.

cards.title: Kiro Knowledge Verified
cards.description: You've mastered Kiro's features. Two paths have opened ahead — The Design Room and The Build Pipeline. ⚠️ You MUST complete BOTH to reach the Deploy Gate.

cards.title: The Design Room
cards.description: No architecture docs. No design decisions recorded. The team coded without a plan. AI-DLC's Inception phase would have prevented this.
cards.image_prompt: Empty glass-walled meeting room, blank whiteboard with no diagrams, scattered post-its, uncapped marker, empty chairs, warm afternoon sunlight, contemplative mood, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 Kiro: Enter AI-DLC
cards.description:
💬 Kiro: "This room is about methodology — specifically AI-DLC. AI-Driven Development Lifecycle. Created by Raja SP at AWS.

The key insight: AI-DLC reverses the conversation. Instead of humans telling AI what to do, AI proposes plans and humans validate. I ask the questions, you approve the answers.

New vocabulary:
• Bolts — replace Sprints (hours/days, not weeks)
• Units — replace Epics (cohesive work elements)
• Intent — your high-level business goal

Principle #1: Reimagine, don't retrofit. AI-DLC isn't Agile with AI bolted on."

cards.title: Methodology Ordered
cards.description: Intent drives Units, which break into Bolts. AI proposes, the team validates in Mob sessions. That's the AI-DLC flow.

cards.title: Spec Workflow Complete
cards.description: Design Room complete! You've earned the AI-DLC Blueprint. Now head to The Build Pipeline to earn the Pipeline Token — you need both to reach the Deploy Gate.

cards.title: The Build Pipeline
cards.description: Time to rebuild. The pipeline needs AI-DLC's three phases restored: Inception, Construction, Operations. Each phase builds on the previous one's context.
cards.image_prompt: DevOps dashboard on wall-mounted monitor showing CI/CD pipeline with 3 stages being rebuilt, green amber grey indicators, terminal windows, warm office lighting with blue tech glow, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 Kiro: The Three Phases
cards.description:
💬 Kiro: "AI-DLC has three phases. Think of them as the highway you're driving:

🟠 Inception — Mob Elaboration. I decompose your business intent into Units and User Stories. Your whole team validates in real-time. No solo architect making decisions alone.

🔵 Construction — Mob Construction. I propose architecture, domain models, code + tests. Developers validate trade-offs and can override my decisions.

🟢 Operations — I monitor telemetry and propose actions. Developers approve.

Each phase provides richer context for the next. That's how you build better systems faster."

cards.title: Build Knowledge Confirmed
cards.description: You nailed the rapid-fire round. AI leads, humans validate. Bolts, not Sprints. That's the AI-DLC way.

cards.title: Pipeline Restored
cards.description: Pipeline rebuilt! You've earned the Pipeline Token. The Deploy Gate is now open — if you've completed both branches.

cards.title: The Final Review
cards.description: The last checkpoint. Prove your Kiro and AI-DLC knowledge one more time — no shortcuts.
cards.image_prompt: Startup office with big monitor showing glowing green deploy button, confetti cannons ready, celebration mode lighting, warm orange and green, party streamers, triumphant mood, isometric game art

cards.title: 💬 Kiro: The Final Review
cards.description:
💬 Kiro: "You've made it. You traced the crash, learned how I work, understood AI-DLC, and rebuilt the pipeline.

Two final checks. First, show me you can start a Kiro session from the CLI. Then run through the readiness checklist — the same things this team skipped the first time.

Get these right and Employee #404 stops being a prophecy."

cards.title: Session Started
cards.description: kiro-cli — session started. You're back in control.

cards.title: 404 → 200 OK 🎉
cards.description:
The server was throwing 404s — the 'page not found' error that means everything's broken. Now it's returning 200 OK — the code for 'everything's working.'

Employee #404 just turned a 404 into a 200. On your first day, thirty minutes after badging in.

The engineering team erupts. Someone posts 'THE PROPHECY WAS WRONG.' The CTO leans on your desk, nods once, and says: 'Okay. You belong here.'

You didn't just patch it — you rebuilt it right: specs first, AI-DLC throughout, humans owning the decisions. Welcome to the team, #404.

cards.title: ✅ Evidence Report
cards.description: You connected the evidence board correctly. The CTO's investigation findings are clear.

cards.title: ✅ Incident Timeline
cards.description: The spec-driven development flow is now clear. You understand what should have happened.

cards.title: ✅ Feature Map
cards.description: Kiro's features are mapped. Specs, Hooks, Steering, Powers, Permissions — all connected.

cards.title: ✅ Methodology Chain
cards.description: The AI-DLC pipeline chain is ordered correctly. Intent → Elaboration → Inception → Construction → Operations.

cards.title: ✅ Build Streak
cards.description: You aced the rapid-fire AI-DLC quiz. The build knowledge is confirmed.

cards.title: ✅ CLI Session
cards.description: You started a Kiro CLI session. One final review left.
